description: Web crawling, scraping, search, and data extraction API designed for AI agents and LLMs.
auth_notes: Authenticate via Bearer token using an API key (Authorization: Bearer <token>) or via MCP/OAuth login flows.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account self-serve to get 1,000 free credits per month without a credit card.
api_notes: Covers search, scrape, batch scrape, crawl, map, browser interaction sessions, parse, and agent endpoints.
mcp_notes: Official MCP server and connectors provided by MendableAI/Firecrawl for AI agents and clients.
rationale: Firecrawl offers a fully documented public REST API, official SDKs, an official MCP server, and self-serve free credentials.
